spans.s:
The affix वुञ् comes optionally after the words 1. ग्रीष्म and 2. वसन्त in the sense of 'sown'.

Terms: वुञ्

The affix वुञ् comes in the sense of 'debt due' after the words 1. ग्रीष्म and 2. अवरसम।

Terms: वुञ्

The affix अण् also (as well as ढञ् ) comes after the word ग्रीवा in the sense of 'what stays there'.

Terms: अण्
